meta.title: perf: Optimize team bookings query by using batch version
meta.body_summary: Replace single-user team bookings query with batch version in two interval-limits functions to reduce database queries and improve performance.

perf_labels.notes: Devin attempted to replace single-user query with batch version inside loops, then self-closed realizing the batch call must be moved outside loops; no human review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 8 changed lines across two files, this is an extremely small edit by absolute volume. It is a tiny performance PR that was closed without merge because the approach did not actually address the underlying loop inefficiency.

review_details.concern_detail: The agent self-identified that using the batch version inside the same loops was insufficient; the function calls need to be moved outside loops to truly reduce database load.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce database queries and improve performance by using batch team bookings query.
review_details.rejection_signals: Agent self-closed PR stating that the batch calls must be moved outside loops rather than just swapping the function inside loops.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Devin was able to identify the batch API and apply it, but failed to correctly restructure the code to utilize batching effectively (moving calls outside loops). This shows a limitation in algorithmic reasoning about batch processing patterns.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmarks or before/after measurements; only narrative claim. Agent self-closed before any external verification.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed by agent without human intervention, recognizing the implementation was insufficient.

core_change_summary.description: In checkBookingLimits.ts and getBusyTimesFromLimits.ts, changed calls from BookingRepository.getAllAcceptedTeamBookingsOfUser to the batch version getAllAcceptedTeamBookingsOfUsers, but left the calls inside existing loops.
